rationale:
A handler has said, in its own payload, 'I cannot do this work' on every cta_improvement item it ever received, and the item completed anyway — 993 items, 22 sites, 0 ever fixed (archive-inclusive; the live table is a 7-day window). Diagnosis loop run b218f39d CONFIRMED the mechanism in 3 iterations, citing the same lines.

THE MECHANISM, read not inferred. write_audit_findings_action.go classifyFinding Rule 3 routes every `cta`/`nav_restructure` audit finding (five live producers: design-audit, content-quality-audit, site-review, offer-analysis, brief-fidelity-audit) at component-template-fixer as cta_improvement/nav_restructure with spec.fix_type the same. fix_component_template_action.go's dispatch switch has, since 2026-03-14 (e535d4f52), returned {fixed:false, action:'needs_review', reason:'fix_type requires LLM-driven changes, not programmatic HTML edits'} for both. Nothing reads `action`: the fixer's workflow branches check_needs_rerender on fix_result.fixed only, then a success-labelled complete_workflow; build-dispatch-loop calls complete_work_item, whose gate 1 reads response.status (this handler never sets it — complete_workflow has no config key for it) and whose gate 1b is opt-in per type with numeric CounterPaths (cta_improvement is not on it, and its payload is a boolean). The comment at fix_component_template_action.go:58 claiming the flag 'stops the dispatch loop recording the work item as done' is FALSE (Go grep for result['action'] readers: none; live workflow-condition census for 'needs_review': none).

THE FINDING THAT CHANGES THE DESIGN. The filing lane wrote that spacing_fix's 'already has flex CSS' and this refusal are the same shape, separable only by reason prose. They are not: every REFUSAL arm in the fixer (13 emission sites) carries action:'needs_review'; every idempotent NO-OP arm carries no action key. MEASURED 2026-08-19 over every row this handler ever produced: action=needs_review on 470 (468 cta_improvement + 2 responsive_fix 'missing slot_name' refusals); fixed=false without action on 299 (226 spacing_fix + 72 responsive_fix + 1 instance_scope_conversion); overlap either way ZERO. The discriminator exists and is machine-readable; only a reader was missing.

WHAT IS ALREADY DONE, LIVE AND PROVEN (config, not in this submission's edits): migration 495 gives the fixer's workflow a check_refused conditional (fix_result.action == 'needs_review') → park_refused (fail_work_item, status_override needs_human_review) — the page-build-handler 'park visibly' pattern, and the same shape/key the 283 lane's pending 486_HOLD uses for judged_refusal on this same agent (the two anchor on different steps and compose in either order). Applied 20:02Z, verified by re-reading the row, then PROVEN by dispatching the real fixer at a probe item on system.internal: path ensure_site_record→apply_fix→check_needs_rerender→check_refused→park_refused→compose_note→append_note→complete, item claimed→needs_human_review with the 323 literal in .error, note titled 'refused: cta_improvement' quoting the reason; probe and note torn down. Blast radius measured: 470 historical refusals would have parked, 0 legitimate completions blocked.

WHAT THIS SUBMISSION IS: the Go half — (2) the ROUTER stops sending cta/nav_restructure at a handler that refuses them by design, filing the estate's 'found work I have no handler for' record instead (capability_gap, gap_kind handler_missing, bugs_closed/077 owner ruling; this router already does exactly this for unknown categories), with the finding's own severity/suggestion/acceptance_test preserved in spec and one open row per site per category; and (3) a build-time LOCKSTEP: the fixer's by-design refusals become a package-level map the switch consults, and a test drives the category universe through classifyFinding and fails if any route hands the fixer a refused fix_type (resolving the fix_type the HANDLER would see — spec.fix_type, then its category/item_type fallbacks — so an omitted spec.fix_type cannot hide one). Mutation-proven: re-adding cta to categoryToFixType and routing it at the fixer fails both halves; restored file passes.

WHY capability_gap AND NOT content_rewrite (page-build-handler): a whole-page regeneration for a button label rewrites copy that was fine, refuses owned pages (bugs_open/301) and is bugs_open/238's mechanism; Rule 4's dedup key would also swallow a CTA finding under any open content finding on the same page. WHY NOT keep routing at the fixer and rely on 495 parking each item: that spends a spawn and an LLM note per finding to produce a needs_human_review row in a 983-row queue; the owner's 077 ruling says this shape is a roadmap row. WHY NOT gate 1b (bug candidate 3): with the router no longer sending the type there is no consumer for a boolean counter, and widening a shared contract for one consumer is the candidate the bug itself ranks last.

SCOPE. Not architecture-scope by the 2026-07-29 ruling 1: no shared mechanism's GUARANTEE changes. classifyFinding's contract (a finding becomes a work item or a capability_gap) is unchanged; two categories move from a dead route to the existing gap shape. The fixer's behaviour for every fix_type is byte-identical (the refused set is lifted out of the switch into a map the default arm consults; the reason string is kept verbatim because the 323 census keys on it). No new item_type, no new status, no new key on a shared action. CONSUMERS TOLD, not just measured (ruling 07-29 §3): the five auditor prompts describe cta→'component fixer' — they are not wrong to emit the category; brief-fidelity-auditor's routing hint goes stale and is noted, not churned. The copy_quality_two_stage lane is told it has a THIRD customer for the 'one component, one defect → field_updates' editor the 277 and 301/083 lanes asked it about today; this lane does NOT build that (a new LLM write-route into live pages is the owner's call).

NOT CLAIMED: that the 468 CTAs are unimproved. Graded at page_component_history: DESTINATION defects have a live deterministic repair (internal-link resolver / cta_links_stale recompute) that runs regardless of the item — robot-hands.com/index was corrected ~2h after filing by that route; LABEL/COPY defects have no handler at all. The Go half is inert until the next chassis roll; until then 495 parks every refusal visibly.
